title: Narrative Review Questions
description: Questions that guide story-first reviewer reasoning.

entries.title: What is the story doing overall?
entries.description: Start with the full scene before judging a sentence.

entries.title: Who is speaking or narrating?
entries.description: Separate character speech from narrator voice.

entries.title: Who or what is the target of the scene?
What is the narrative intent?
entries.description: Decide whether the scene is endorsement, criticism, neutral narration, or fiction.

entries.title: What context changes the meaning?
entries.description: Track flashback, dream, voice over, and unreliable narration.

entries.title: Does earlier or later memory change the reading?
entries.description: Cross-scene context can reverse a first impression.

entries.title: How confident is the reading?
entries.description: Confidence should fall when context is incomplete.
